apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Shared secret checked against the applet's configured API key

searchQuery.label: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Full Trilium search expression used to find candidate notes. Must reference the same label named in Date Label below (e.g. add "~template.title='1. Routine' AND" to only surface Routine-templated notes).

dateLabel.label: Date Label
dateLabel.description: Name of the label used to store due dates on tasks — used to filter results down to the current minute after the search query runs

taskOrder.label: Task Order
taskOrder.description: Whether to surface the earliest or latest matching past-due task
